{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Note: The documentation says revenue is exported as text with thousands separators
# Example: '1,234.56' → 1234.56
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders — these are flagged as revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print('QA orders found:', len(qa_orders))

# Remove QA orders
data_clean = data[~(data['revenue'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'refunded']
print('Refunded orders:', len(refunded))

# Remove refunded orders — they don't count as conversions
data_clean = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Verify we have a clean dataset
print('Final data shape:', data_clean.shape)

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered = data_clean[
    (data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (data_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

print('Filtered group size:', len(filtered))

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
if len(filtered) > 0:
    conversion_rate = filtered['converted'].mean()
    print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')
else:
    print('No NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH in completed orders.')"}
